name: vscode-router-goto
description: Smart autocomplete, Click-to-Definition (Cmd+click) and hover documentation for Expo Router & React Navigation screens and params.

commands.title: Router Goto: Rescan Navigation Routes & ParamLists
Router Goto: Show All Registered Routes

routerGoto.enable.description: Enable or disable Router Goto extension features.

routerGoto.enableExpoRouter.description: Enable Expo Router scanning, autocomplete, and navigation.

routerGoto.enableReactNavigation.description: Enable React Navigation scanning (ParamList & Stack.Screen), autocomplete, and navigation.

routerGoto.enableReactRouter.description: Enable React Router (react-router-dom) scanning (<Route> & createBrowserRouter), autocomplete, and navigation.

routerGoto.appDirectories.description: Directories to scan for Expo Router routes.

routerGoto.preferComponentDefinition.description: When jumping to definition in React Navigation, jump directly to the Screen Component file if available, rather than the ParamList type declaration.

routerGoto.enableHover.description: Show rich route information & parameter details on hover.

routerGoto.enableDocumentLinks.description: Turn route strings into direct clickable links (Cmd/Ctrl + Click).

routerGoto.enableDiagnostics.description: Show warning squiggles for route strings that do not match any known route in the workspace.
